Name: Negative ROI protection
Condition: Penalise Increase when ROI is negative
Classification_Basis: Negative ROI is adverse evidence but may be temporarily accepted under an explicitly reviewed recovery strategy.

Name: Low conversion protection
Condition: Penalise Increase when conversion rate is below 8%
Classification_Basis: A low conversion rate is a warning signal whose interpretation depends on campaign objective and funnel stage.

Name: Low CTR protection
Condition: Penalise Increase when CTR is below 3%
Classification_Basis: CTR is channel- and objective-dependent, so the threshold adjusts preference without declaring infeasibility.

Name: Low engagement protection
Condition: Penalise Increase when engagement is below 5
Classification_Basis: Engagement is supporting evidence rather than a necessary condition for every campaign action.

Name: Evidence sufficiency
Condition: Exclude Increase and Reduce below 500 clicks or 50 conversions
Classification_Basis: A decisive scale-up or reduction is not permitted when the predefined minimum evidence requirement is unmet.

Name: Strong signal protection
Condition: Penalise Reduce when at least two performance signals are strong
Classification_Basis: Strong signals oppose reduction but do not make it operationally impossible when other managerial constraints exist.

Name: Exceptional performance
Condition: Penalise Maintain when all core signals are exceptional
Classification_Basis: Exceptional performance supports expansion but does not prohibit a manager from maintaining the current plan.

Name: Growth intent safeguard
Classification_Basis: The manager-supplied primary intent is a declared decision constraint; Reduce directly contradicts Growth.

Name: Survival intent safeguard
Classification_Basis: The manager-supplied primary intent is a declared decision constraint; Increase directly contradicts cash preservation.

Name: Retention intent safeguard
Classification_Basis: The manager-supplied primary intent is a declared decision constraint; Reduce directly contradicts relationship continuity.

Name: Acquisition cost protection
Condition: Penalise Increase when acquisition cost exceeds revenue per conversion
Classification_Basis: The cost signal is economically adverse but remains estimate-dependent and may be overridden after explicit review.

Name: Channel saturation
Condition: Penalise Increase when exposure is high but CTR is weak
Classification_Basis: High exposure with weak response is a warning rather than proof that every expansion configuration is infeasible.

Name: Budget feasibility
Condition: Exclude Increase when the supplied budget cannot support 50 additional acquisitions
Classification_Basis: An explicitly supplied insufficient budget makes the scale-up action infeasible; missing budget is escalated instead of treated as safe.

Name: Conflicting evidence
Condition: Exclude executable actions and require manual review when strong and weak signals conflict
Classification_Basis: Materially conflicting evidence prevents automatic execution; Investigate is retained only as the manual-review fallback.
